Name: General
$Comment: The everyday token storefront. 'currencies' is the balance strip in the page header: list every wallet this shop actually prices in, so a player can see what they can afford before they browse. Omit the field to show bounty tokens alone. 'categoryOrder' fixes the order the catalog's categories appear in; leave it out and categories sort alphabetically, which puts 'rare' ahead of 'uncommon'. Any category not named here follows the listed ones, alphabetically, and each offer's own 'order' still sorts offers within a single category.
